capabilities: display a hidden heading outline as a dash column in an editor corner
expand the dashes into an outline card on hover and jump to entries
split journal notes into DONE / DOING / TODO sections at horizontal rules
configure position, heading depth, and journal folder in settings
extras: Installable manually from Releases or via BRAT; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Docs are available in English and Simplified Chinese.
problem: Obsidian's outline takes space or requires opening a panel; this keeps heading navigation available without occupying visible editor space.
summary: Hidden table of contents shown as a column of short dashes in an editor corner, expanding into an outline card on hover for quick navigation.
